title: A finite density gives μ(B_ρ(x)) ≤ ofReal(Cρ^n) for small ρ (step 4)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N, let x ∈ ℝ^N, and let θ ∈ [0,∞] with θ ≠ ∞. Suppose HasDensity n μ x θ holds. That is, densityRatio n μ x ρ = μ(B_ρ(x)) / (ω_n·ofReal(ρ)^n) → θ in [0,∞] as ρ → 0 with ρ > 0. Here ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the volume of the open unit ball of ℝ^n, and B_ρ(x) = closedBall x ρ. Then there are C ∈ ℝ and r > 0 such that μ(B_ρ(x)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(C·ρ^n) for every ρ ∈ (0, r).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (θ : ℝ≥0∞), HasDensity n μ x θ → θ ≠ ∞ → ∃ C r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r → μ (closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)
